ops.quote: The encoder E : S(X ×A)×X → Z K converts an image xt into zt = (zt1 , . . . , ztK ), a sequence of K discrete ∆-tokens.
The CNN decoder D : S(X × A) × Z K → X reconstructs an image x̂t from past frames, actions and ∆tokens (x0 , a0 , . . . , xt−1 , at−1 , zt ).
The dynamics model G outputs a categorical distribution on Z for the next ∆-token ẑtk+1 ∼ pG (ẑtk+1 |x̃<t , z<t , a<t , zt≤k ).
It also predicts distributions for rewards pG (r̂t |x̃≤t z≤t , a≤t ) and episode terminations pG (dˆt |x̃≤t , z≤t , a≤t ).
The policy π learns in the imagination POMDP of its world model, composed of the autoencoder (E, D) and the dynamics model G.
The world model then predicts the reward r̂t , the episode end dˆt , and the next observation x̂t+1 = D(x̂≤t , â≤t , ẑ≤t , ẑt+1 ), with ẑt+1 ∼ pG (ẑt+1 |x̂≤t , â≤t , ẑ≤t ).
The dynamics model G is parameterized by a stack of transformer encoder layers with causal self-attention (Vaswani et al., 2017; Radford et al., 2019).
We use a straight-through estimator (Bengio et al., 2013) to enable backpropagation.
The CNN decoder D : S(X × A) × Z K → X reconstructs an image x̂t from past frames, actions and ∆tokens (x0 , a0 , . . . , xt−1 , at−1 , zt ).
Image and action tokens are embedded with learnt lookup tables.
Actions are embedded with a learnt lookup table and concatenated channel-wise with frames.
